task_target: leading eigenvector; final layer-4 normalized direction readout
probe_target: q_k = normalize((XX^T)^k a), eight independently calibrated targets
probe_loss: mean(1 - squared cosine), bias-free linear maps; validation-only checkpoint selection
pairing: same data, initialization, batches, precision and learning-rate schedule
gap: absolute difference of final validation mean(1 - squared cosine) errors
flag_rule: gap strictly greater than 0.1; retain every seed
pause_rule: at least 8 pairs and flagged fraction strictly greater than 0.5
failure_policy: save and halt on numerical or implementation failures; flag large performance gaps and apply cohort pause rule
analysis: save test, probe and bypass results for every model, including flagged seeds; also summarize unflagged pairs separately
layers: input 0 and network layers 1-4, eight power probes per layer
negative_control: permute fit and validation labels separately; true test labels retained
bypass: skip residual update, keep normalizer; length-matched and plain bypass
